    <section class="py-12 md:py-16" id="try-terminal">
      <div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
    
        <div class="rr-demo-signed-in-nudge">
          <span class="rr-signed-in-msg">
            You're signed in - this demo returns sample data.
          </span>
          <a href="https://app.reqres.in/playground" class="rr-signed-in-cta">
            Open the real playground →
          </a>
        </div>
    
        <!-- Section Header -->
        <div data-reveal class="text-center mb-6 md:mb-8">
          <div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-400/70 font-semibold mb-3">
            Try it now
          </div>
          <h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white mb-2">
            Your backend, live in your browser.
          </h2>
          <p class="text-sm text-white/50">
            No signup required. Just hit Send.
          </p>
        </div>
    
        <!-- Audience Toggle -->
        <div data-reveal class="flex justify-center mb-4" id="audienceToggle">
          <div class="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.02] p-1">
            <button data-audience="testing" class="audience-btn active" type="button">
              I'm testing something
            </button>
            <button data-audience="building" class="audience-btn" type="button">
              I'm building something
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p id="audienceTagline" data-reveal class="text-center text-sm text-white/55 mb-6 max-w-xl mx-auto content-fade">
          Predictable API responses for your test suite - Playwright, Cypress, or Postman.
        </p>
    
        <!-- Terminal Container -->
        <div data-reveal id="terminalWidget" class="rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.06] bg-[#111217] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl shadow-black/30">
    
          <!-- Terminal Header Bar -->
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02]">
            <div class="flex gap-1.5">
              <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full" style="background: #FF5F56;"></span>
              <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full" style="background: #FFBD2E;"></span>
              <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full" style="background: #27C93F;"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="text-[11px] text-white/40 terminal-font ml-2">reqres-terminal</span>
          </div>
    
          <!-- Boot Sequence Container -->
          <div id="bootSequence" class="p-5 terminal-font text-sm leading-relaxed min-h-[220px]">
            <div id="bootLines"></div>
            <span id="bootCursor" class="terminal-cursor"></span>
          </div>
    
          <!-- API Explorer Container (visible but dimmed during boot) -->
          <div id="apiExplorer" class="explorer-dimmed">
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2">
    
              <!-- Request Panel -->
              <div class="border-b lg:border-b-0 lg:border-r border-white/[0.06] p-5">
                <div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-white/50 font-semibold mb-4">Request</div>
    
                <!-- Nudge Prompt (hidden initially) -->
                <div id="nudgePrompt" class="hidden nudge-prompt">
                  <span id="nudgeText">That's stored. Now fetch it back</span>
                  <svg class="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/>
                  </svg>
                </div>
    
                <!-- Method Pills -->
                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4" id="methodPills" role="group" aria-label="HTTP Method">
                  <button data-method="GET" class="method-pill" type="button">GET</button>
                  <button data-method="POST" class="method-pill active" type="button">POST</button>
                  <button data-method="PUT" class="method-pill" type="button">PUT</button>
                  <button data-method="DELETE" class="method-pill" type="button">DELETE</button>
                </div>
    
                <!-- Endpoint Display -->
                <div class="rounded-lg border border-white/[0.08] bg-black/30 px-3 py-2.5 mb-4 overflow-x-auto">
                  <code class="text-[13px] terminal-font whitespace-nowrap">
                    <span id="endpointBase" class="text-white/40">https://reqres.in/api/my-app/</span><span id="endpointPath" class="text-emerald-400">collections/todos/records</span>
                  </code>
                </div>
    
                <!-- JSON Body Editor with Syntax Highlighting -->
                <div id="bodyEditorContainer" class="mb-4">
                  <label for="requestBody" class="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-white/40 mb-2">Body</label>
                  <div class="code-editor-wrapper">
                    <pre id="requestBodyHighlight" class="code-editor-highlight" aria-hidden="true"></pre>
                    <textarea
                      id="requestBody"
                      class="code-editor-textarea"
                      spellcheck="false"
                      aria-label="Request body JSON"
                    ></textarea>
                  </div>
                </div>
    
                <!-- Send Button -->
                <button
                  id="sendBtn"
                  type="button"
                  class="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-black font-semibold text-sm transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-400 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#111217]"
                >
                  <span id="sendBtnText">Send</span>
                  <svg id="sendBtnArrow" class="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>
                    <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span id="sendBtnDots" class="loading-dots hidden">
                    <span>.</span><span>.</span><span>.</span>
                  </span>
                </button>
              </div>
    
              <!-- Response Panel -->
              <div class="p-5" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
                <div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-white/50 font-semibold mb-4">Response</div>
    
                <!-- Status Badge & Time -->
                <div id="responseStatus" class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 min-h-[28px]">
                  <!-- Populated dynamically -->
                </div>
    
                <!-- Response Body -->
                <pre id="responseBody" class="rounded-lg border border-white/[0.08] bg-black/40 p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed terminal-font overflow-x-auto min-h-[120px] max-h-[280px] overflow-y-auto text-white/60">// Response will appear here</pre>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
    
        <!-- CTA Banner (hidden initially) -->
        <div id="ctaBanner" class="hidden mt-6">
          <div class="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-400/20 bg-emerald-400/[0.03] p-5 md:p-6 text-center">
            <p class="text-[15px] text-white/80 mb-2">
              That's a real backend. Yours is 30 seconds away.
            </p>
            <p class="text-[13px] text-white/50 mb-4">
              Database, API, and auth - from a URL. No code. No deploy.
            </p>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
              <a
                href="https://app.reqres.in"
                class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-black font-semibold text-sm transition-colors"
              >
                Create your backend
                <svg class="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/>
                </svg>
              </a>
              <a
                href="https://app.reqres.in/examples/notes-app"
                class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 text-white/70 hover:text-white hover:border-white/20 text-sm transition-colors"
              >
                See example app
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
    
      </div>
    </section>
    
    <script>
    (function() {
      'use strict';
    
      // Audience-specific configurations
      const audienceConfig = {
        building: {
          tagline: 'Ship your frontend with a real backend - no Express, no Postgres, no deploy.',
          projectName: 'my-app',
          collectionName: 'todos',
          defaultBody: {
            title: 'Ship the frontend',
            completed: false
          },
          nudgeText: "That's stored. Now fetch it back"
        },
        testing: {
          tagline: 'Predictable API responses for your test suite - Playwright, Cypress, or Postman.',
          projectName: 'test-suite',
          collectionName: 'users',
          defaultBody: {
            name: 'Jane Doe',
            email: 'jane@example.com',
            role: 'admin'
          },
          nudgeText: 'Data persists between requests. Verify it'
        }
      };
    
      // Checklist items (what you're skipping)
      const checklistItems = [
        'Install & configure Postgres',
        'Write API routes & controllers',
        'Add authentication middleware',
        'Set up hosting & deployment',
        'Configure logging & monitoring'
      ];
    
      // State
      const state = {
        phase: 'boot',
        audience: 'testing',
        method: 'POST',
        records: [],
        requestCount: 0,
        bootComplete: false,
        ctaShown: false,
        isLoading: false,
        hasInteracted: false
      };
    
      // DOM elements (cached after DOMContentLoaded)
      let elements = {};
    
      // Get current config
      function getConfig() {
        return audienceConfig[state.audience];
      }
    
      // Utilities
      function generateId() {
        const chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
        let id = 'rec_';
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
          id += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
        }
        return id;
      }
    
      function sleep(ms) {
        return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
      }
    
      function getTimestamp() {
        return new Date().toISOString();
      }
    
      // JSON syntax highlighting (for objects)
      function highlightJSON(obj) {
        if (obj === null) return '<span class="json-null">null</span>';
        if (obj === undefined) return '';
    
        const json = JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2);
        return highlightJSONString(json);
      }
    
      // JSON syntax highlighting (for raw strings)
      function highlightJSONString(str) {
        if (!str) return '';
        return str
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"([^"]+)":/g, '<span class="json-key">"$1"</span>:')
          .replace(/: "([^"]*)"(,?)/g, ': <span class="json-string">"$1"</span>$2')
          .replace(/: (-?\d+\.?\d*)(,?)/g, ': <span class="json-number">$1</span>$2')
          .replace(/: (true|false)(,?)/g, ': <span class="json-boolean">$1</span>$2')
          .replace(/: (null)(,?)/g, ': <span class="json-null">$1</span>$2')
          .replace(/([{}\[\]])/g, '<span class="json-bracket">$1</span>');
      }
    
      // Update request body highlighting
      function updateRequestBodyHighlight() {
        if (elements.requestBodyHighlight && elements.requestBody) {
          const value = elements.requestBody.value;
          elements.requestBodyHighlight.innerHTML = highlightJSONString(value) + '\n';
        }
      }
    
      // Boot sequence - "what you're skipping" framing
      async function startBootSequence() {
        const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
        const config = getConfig();
    
        // Show boot sequence, keep explorer visible but dimmed
        elements.bootSequence.style.display = 'block';
        elements.apiExplorer.classList.remove('hidden');
        elements.apiExplorer.classList.add('explorer-dimmed');
        elements.apiExplorer.classList.remove('explorer-active');
    
        if (reduceMotion) {
          showFinalBootState();
          await sleep(300);
          transitionToExplorer();
          return;
        }
    
        const bootLinesContainer = elements.bootLines;
        const cursor = elements.bootCursor;
    
        // Phase 1: "Setting up your backend the usual way..." (0.6s)
        const line1 = document.createElement('div');
        line1.className = 'boot-line';
        line1.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/70">> Setting up your backend the usual way...</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line1);
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(cursor);
        await sleep(600);
    
        // Phase 2: Checklist items (2s total = 0.4s each)
        const checklistEls = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < checklistItems.length; i++) {
          const item = document.createElement('div');
          item.className = 'checklist-item';
          item.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.05) + 's';
          item.innerHTML = `<span class="checkbox">\u25A1</span><span class="text">${checklistItems[i]}</span>`;
          bootLinesContainer.appendChild(item);
          checklistEls.push(item);
          await sleep(400);
        }
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(cursor);
    
        // Phase 3: Pause then "Actually... skip all that." with emphasis
        await sleep(600);
        const line2 = document.createElement('div');
        line2.className = 'boot-line';
        line2.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/70">> Actually... </span><span class="text-emerald-400">skip all that.</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line2);
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(cursor);
    
        // Hold on "skip all that" for emphasis
        await sleep(1200);
    
        // Phase 4: Strike through cascade (~120ms each)
        for (let i = 0; i < checklistEls.length; i++) {
          checklistEls[i].classList.add('struck');
          await sleep(120);
        }
    
        // Pause after strikethrough completes
        await sleep(400);
    
        // Phase 5: ReqRes lines
        const line3 = document.createElement('div');
        line3.className = 'boot-line';
        line3.innerHTML = '<span class="text-emerald-400">> reqres.in/api/' + config.projectName + ' \u2713</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line3);
        await sleep(300);
    
        const line4 = document.createElement('div');
        line4.className = 'boot-line';
        line4.innerHTML = '<span class="text-emerald-400">> Database, API, auth, logs - live.</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line4);
        await sleep(300);
    
        // Empty line
        const emptyLine = document.createElement('div');
        emptyLine.innerHTML = '&nbsp;';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(emptyLine);
    
        const line5 = document.createElement('div');
        line5.className = 'boot-line';
        line5.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/60">> Try it <span class="arrow-bounce">\u2193</span></span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line5);
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(cursor);
    
        // Pause before transitioning to explorer
        await sleep(1500);
        transitionToExplorer();
      }
    
      function showFinalBootState() {
        const config = getConfig();
        const bootLinesContainer = elements.bootLines;
    
        // Show struck checklist
        const line1 = document.createElement('div');
        line1.style.opacity = '1';
        line1.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/70">> Setting up your backend the usual way...</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line1);
    
        checklistItems.forEach(item => {
          const el = document.createElement('div');
          el.className = 'checklist-item struck';
          el.style.opacity = '1';
          el.innerHTML = `<span class="checkbox">\u25A1</span><span class="text">${item}</span>`;
          bootLinesContainer.appendChild(el);
        });
    
        const line2 = document.createElement('div');
        line2.style.opacity = '1';
        line2.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/70">> Actually... </span><span class="text-emerald-400">skip all that.</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line2);
    
        const line3 = document.createElement('div');
        line3.style.opacity = '1';
        line3.innerHTML = '<span class="text-emerald-400">> reqres.in/api/' + config.projectName + ' \u2713</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line3);
    
        const line4 = document.createElement('div');
        line4.style.opacity = '1';
        line4.innerHTML = '<span class="text-emerald-400">> Database, API, auth, logs - live.</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line4);
    
        const emptyLine = document.createElement('div');
        emptyLine.innerHTML = '&nbsp;';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(emptyLine);
    
        const line5 = document.createElement('div');
        line5.style.opacity = '1';
        line5.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/60">> Try it \u2193</span>';
        bootLinesContainer.appendChild(line5);
    
        elements.bootCursor.style.display = 'none';
      }
    
      function transitionToExplorer() {
        state.bootComplete = true;
        state.phase = 'explorer';
    
        elements.bootSequence.style.display = 'none';
        elements.apiExplorer.classList.remove('explorer-dimmed');
        elements.apiExplorer.classList.add('explorer-active');
    
        // Set default body for current audience
        const config = getConfig();
        elements.requestBody.value = JSON.stringify(config.defaultBody, null, 2);
        updateRequestBodyHighlight();
    
        // Update endpoint
        updateEndpoint();
    
        // Set initial method
        setMethod('POST');
      }
    
      // Update endpoint display based on current audience and method
      function updateEndpoint() {
        const config = getConfig();
        const basePath = 'https://reqres.in/api/' + config.projectName + '/';
        elements.endpointBase.textContent = basePath;
    
        if (state.method === 'PUT' || state.method === 'DELETE') {
          if (state.records.length > 0) {
            elements.endpointPath.textContent = 'collections/' + config.collectionName + '/records/' + state.records[0].id;
          } else {
            elements.endpointPath.textContent = 'collections/' + config.collectionName + '/records/:id';
          }
        } else {
          elements.endpointPath.textContent = 'collections/' + config.collectionName + '/records';
        }
      }
    
      // Method switching
      function setMethod(method) {
        state.method = method;
    
        // Update pills
        document.querySelectorAll('.method-pill').forEach(pill => {
          pill.classList.toggle('active', pill.dataset.method === method);
          pill.classList.remove('pulse-get');
        });
    
        // Show/hide body editor
        const showBody = method === 'POST' || method === 'PUT';
        elements.bodyEditorContainer.style.display = showBody ? 'block' : 'none';
    
        // Update endpoint
        updateEndpoint();
    
        // Pre-fill PUT body
        if (method === 'PUT' && state.records.length > 0) {
          const record = state.records[0];
          if (state.audience === 'building') {
            elements.requestBody.value = JSON.stringify({
              title: record.title,
              completed: true
            }, null, 2);
          } else {
            elements.requestBody.value = JSON.stringify({
              name: record.name,
              email: record.email,
              role: 'superadmin'
            }, null, 2);
          }
          updateRequestBodyHighlight();
        } else if (method === 'POST') {
          const config = getConfig();
          elements.requestBody.value = JSON.stringify(config.defaultBody, null, 2);
          updateRequestBodyHighlight();
        }
    
        // Hide nudge prompt when switching to GET
        if (method === 'GET') {
          elements.nudgePrompt.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }
    
      // API handlers with realistic response times
      const apiHandlers = {
        GET: () => {
          const delay = 8 + Math.random() * 17; // 8-25ms
          return {
            status: 200,
            statusText: '200 OK',
            statusClass: 'status-success',
            delay,
            body: {
              data: state.records,
              total: state.records.length,
              page: 1,
              per_page: 20
            }
          };
        },
    
        POST: (body) => {
          const delay = 18 + Math.random() * 27; // 18-45ms
          const record = {
            id: generateId(),
            ...body,
            createdAt: getTimestamp(),
            updatedAt: getTimestamp()
          };
          state.records.push(record);
          return {
            status: 201,
            statusText: '201 Created',
            statusClass: 'status-success',
            delay,
            body: record,
            showNudge: state.requestCount === 0
          };
        },
    
        PUT: (body) => {
          const delay = 15 + Math.random() * 25; // 15-40ms
          if (state.records.length === 0) {
            return {
              status: 404,
              statusText: '404 Not Found',
              statusClass: 'status-error',
              delay,
              body: { error: 'No record found to update' }
            };
          }
          const record = state.records[0];
          Object.assign(record, body, { updatedAt: getTimestamp() });
          return {
            status: 200,
            statusText: '200 OK',
            statusClass: 'status-success',
            delay,
            body: record
          };
        },
    
        DELETE: () => {
          const delay = 8 + Math.random() * 10; // 8-18ms
          if (state.records.length === 0) {
            return {
              status: 404,
              statusText: '404 Not Found',
              statusClass: 'status-error',
              delay,
              body: { error: 'No record found to delete' }
            };
          }
          state.records.shift();
          return {
            status: 204,
            statusText: '204 No Content',
            statusClass: 'status-neutral',
            delay,
            body: null
          };
        }
      };
    
      // Send request
      async function sendRequest() {
        if (state.isLoading) return;
    
        state.isLoading = true;
        state.hasInteracted = true;
    
        // Button animation
        elements.sendBtn.classList.add('send-click');
        setTimeout(() => elements.sendBtn.classList.remove('send-click'), 100);
    
        // Show loading dots
        elements.sendBtnText.textContent = 'Sending';
        elements.sendBtnArrow.classList.add('hidden');
        elements.sendBtnDots.classList.remove('hidden');
    
        // Parse body if needed
        let body = null;
        if (state.method === 'POST' || state.method === 'PUT') {
          try {
            body = JSON.parse(elements.requestBody.value);
          } catch (e) {
            showResponse({
              status: 400,
              statusText: '400 Bad Request',
              statusClass: 'status-error',
              delay: 5,
              body: { error: 'Invalid JSON in request body' }
            });
            resetSendButton();
            return;
          }
        }
    
        const handler = apiHandlers[state.method];
        const response = handler(body);
    
        // Simulate network delay (add 150ms base for realism)
        await sleep(response.delay + 150);
    
        showResponse(response);
        resetSendButton();
    
        state.requestCount++;
    
        // Show CTA after 2+ requests
        if (state.requestCount >= 2 && !state.ctaShown) {
          showCTA();
        }
      }
    
      function resetSendButton() {
        state.isLoading = false;
        elements.sendBtnText.textContent = 'Send';
        elements.sendBtnArrow.classList.remove('hidden');
        elements.sendBtnDots.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    
      function showResponse(response) {
        // Status badge
        elements.responseStatus.innerHTML = `
          <span class="status-badge ${response.statusClass}">${response.statusText}</span>
          <span class="text-[11px] text-white/40 terminal-font">${Math.round(response.delay)}ms</span>
        `;
    
        // Response body
        if (response.body === null) {
          elements.responseBody.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/40">// No content</span>';
        } else {
          elements.responseBody.innerHTML = highlightJSON(response.body);
        }
    
        // Show nudge after first POST
        if (response.showNudge) {
          // Wait 1 second then show nudge
          setTimeout(() => {
            const config = getConfig();
            elements.nudgePrompt.querySelector('#nudgeText').textContent = config.nudgeText;
            elements.nudgePrompt.classList.remove('hidden');
    
            // Add pulse animation to GET pill
            const getPill = document.querySelector('.method-pill[data-method="GET"]');
            if (getPill) {
              getPill.classList.add('pulse-get');
            }
          }, 1000);
        }
      }
    
      function showCTA() {
        state.ctaShown = true;
        elements.ctaBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
        elements.ctaBanner.classList.add('cta-banner-show');
      }
    
      // Audience toggle
      function setAudience(newAudience) {
        if (newAudience === state.audience) return;
    
        state.audience = newAudience;
    
        // Update toggle buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.audience-btn').forEach(btn => {
          btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.audience === newAudience);
        });
    
        const config = getConfig();
    
        // Fade out tagline, update, fade in
        elements.audienceTagline.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(() => {
          elements.audienceTagline.textContent = config.tagline;
          elements.audienceTagline.style.opacity = '1';
        }, 150);
    
        // If boot is complete, update terminal content
        if (state.bootComplete) {
          // Reset state
          state.records = [];
          state.requestCount = 0;
          state.ctaShown = false;
          elements.ctaBanner.classList.add('hidden');
          elements.ctaBanner.classList.remove('cta-banner-show');
          elements.nudgePrompt.classList.add('hidden');
    
          // Remove pulse from GET pill
          const getPill = document.querySelector('.method-pill[data-method="GET"]');
          if (getPill) getPill.classList.remove('pulse-get');
    
          // Smooth content transition if user has interacted
          if (state.hasInteracted) {
            // Fade out
            elements.requestBody.style.opacity = '0';
            elements.requestBodyHighlight.style.opacity = '0';
            elements.responseBody.style.opacity = '0';
    
            setTimeout(() => {
              // Update content
              elements.requestBody.value = JSON.stringify(config.defaultBody, null, 2);
              updateRequestBodyHighlight();
              updateEndpoint();
              elements.responseBody.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/60">// Response will appear here</span>';
              elements.responseStatus.innerHTML = '';
    
              // Reset to POST
              setMethod('POST');
    
              // Fade in
              elements.requestBody.style.opacity = '1';
              elements.requestBodyHighlight.style.opacity = '1';
              elements.responseBody.style.opacity = '1';
            }, 150);
          } else {
            // Instant update if no interaction yet
            elements.requestBody.value = JSON.stringify(config.defaultBody, null, 2);
            updateRequestBodyHighlight();
            updateEndpoint();
            setMethod('POST');
          }
        }
      }
    
      // Initialize
      function init() {
        // Cache DOM elements
        elements = {
          terminalWidget: document.getElementById('terminalWidget'),
          bootSequence: document.getElementById('bootSequence'),
          bootLines: document.getElementById('bootLines'),
          bootCursor: document.getElementById('bootCursor'),
          apiExplorer: document.getElementById('apiExplorer'),
          methodPills: document.getElementById('methodPills'),
          requestBody: document.getElementById('requestBody'),
          requestBodyHighlight: document.getElementById('requestBodyHighlight'),
          bodyEditorContainer: document.getElementById('bodyEditorContainer'),
          endpointBase: document.getElementById('endpointBase'),
          endpointPath: document.getElementById('endpointPath'),
          sendBtn: document.getElementById('sendBtn'),
          sendBtnText: document.getElementById('sendBtnText'),
          sendBtnArrow: document.getElementById('sendBtnArrow'),
          sendBtnDots: document.getElementById('sendBtnDots'),
          responseStatus: document.getElementById('responseStatus'),
          responseBody: document.getElementById('responseBody'),
          nudgePrompt: document.getElementById('nudgePrompt'),
          ctaBanner: document.getElementById('ctaBanner'),
          audienceTagline: document.getElementById('audienceTagline')
        };
    
        if (!elements.terminalWidget) return;
    
        // Set initial content
        const config = getConfig();
        elements.requestBody.value = JSON.stringify(config.defaultBody, null, 2);
        updateRequestBodyHighlight();
    
        // Method pill clicks
        elements.methodPills.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          const pill = e.target.closest('.method-pill');
          if (pill && !state.isLoading && state.bootComplete) {
            setMethod(pill.dataset.method);
          }
        });
    
        // Send button click
        elements.sendBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (state.bootComplete) sendRequest();
        });
    
        // Keyboard: Enter to send when focused on textarea
        elements.requestBody.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && state.bootComplete) {
            e.preventDefault();
            sendRequest();
          }
        });
    
        // Sync syntax highlighting with textarea input
        elements.requestBody.addEventListener('input', updateRequestBodyHighlight);
        elements.requestBody.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
          if (elements.requestBodyHighlight) {
            elements.requestBodyHighlight.scrollTop = elements.requestBody.scrollTop;
            elements.requestBodyHighlight.scrollLeft = elements.requestBody.scrollLeft;
          }
        });
    
        // Nudge prompt click - switch to GET
        elements.nudgePrompt.addEventListener('click', () => {
          setMethod('GET');
        });
    
        // Audience toggle
        document.getElementById('audienceToggle').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          const btn = e.target.closest('.audience-btn');
          if (btn) {
            setAudience(btn.dataset.audience);
          }
        });
    
        // IntersectionObserver for boot trigger
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
          entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting && !state.bootComplete) {
              observer.unobserve(entry.target);
              startBootSequence();
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.3 });
    
        observer.observe(elements.terminalWidget);
      }
    
      // Run on DOM ready
      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
      } else {
        init();
      }
    })();
    </script>

    <script>
    (function() {
      'use strict';
    
      const grid = document.getElementById('testimonialsGrid');
      if (!grid) return;
    
      const items = grid.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-item');
      if (!items.length) return;
    
      // Check for reduced motion preference
      const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      if (reduceMotion) {
        items.forEach(item => item.classList.add('revealed'));
        return;
      }
    
      // IntersectionObserver for fade-in
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const item = entry.target;
            const index = parseInt(item.dataset.testimonialIndex, 10) || 0;
            // Stagger animation for multiple testimonials
            setTimeout(() => {
              item.classList.add('revealed');
            }, index * 120);
            observer.unobserve(item);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.2 });
    
      items.forEach(item => observer.observe(item));
    })();
    </script>

    <script>
    (function() {
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#compareCards .compare-card');

      cards.forEach(card => {
        // Make cards keyboard-focusable and announce as buttons
        card.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        card.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

        function toggle(e) {
          // Don't toggle if clicking the comparison link
          if (e.target.closest('a')) return;

          const answer = card.querySelector('.compare-answer');
          const isActive = card.classList.contains('active');

          // Close all
          cards.forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('active');
            c.querySelector('.compare-answer').classList.remove('open');
            c.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          });

          // Open clicked (if it wasn't already open)
          if (!isActive) {
            card.classList.add('active');
            answer.classList.add('open');
            card.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          }
        }

        card.addEventListener('click', toggle);
        card.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            toggle(e);
          }
        });
      });
    })();
    </script>

        <script type="application/ld+json">
            {
                "@context": "https://schema.org",
                "@type": "SoftwareApplication",
                "name": "ReqRes – Frontend-first backend",
                "description": "ReqRes is the frontend-first backend you call with fetch(). Projects bundle collections, app users, logs, and automations-no backend code required.",
                "url": "https://reqres.in",
                "applicationCategory": "DeveloperApplication",
                "operatingSystem": "Web",
                "offers": [
                    {
                        "@type": "Offer",
                        "name": "Free Plan",
                        "price": "0",
                        "priceCurrency": "USD",
                        "description": "Start a project with collections, app users, and logs for prototypes, QA, and learning REST."
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Offer",
                        "name": "Pro Plan",
                        "price": "9",
                        "priceCurrency": "USD",
                        "description": "Production-ready backend for frontend developers and QA teams shipping real apps."
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Offer",
                        "name": "Premium Plan",
                        "price": "29",
                        "priceCurrency": "USD",
                        "description": "Higher limits, automations, and org features for production workloads."
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Offer",
                        "name": "Enterprise Plan",
                        "description": "Custom limits, SLAs, security reviews, and dedicated support."
                    }
                ],
                "featureList": [
                    "Collections as a JSON database for your app",
                    "Magic-link auth and project-scoped app users",
                    "App-session tokens to scope data per user",
                    "Built-in Data Explorer and request logs",
                    "Automations and webhooks on collection events",
                    "Keys and permissions for admin vs client usage",
                    "Frontend-only integration via fetch(), no backend code",
                    "Client-only apps, QA automation, and teaching REST/HTTP",
                    "Ideal for MVPs, production apps, and internal tools"
                ]
            }
        </script>
        <script type="application/ld+json">
            {
                "@context": "https://schema.org",
                "@type": "FAQPage",
                "mainEntity": [
                    {
                        "@type": "Question",
                        "name": "What is a frontend-first backend?",
                        "acceptedAnswer": {
                            "@type": "Answer",
                            "text": "A frontend-first backend gives you production-grade data, auth, and automations without standing up servers. ReqRes lets you create projects with collections, app users, magic-link auth, and logs so your frontend can ship with real data and stay production-ready."
                        }
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Question",
                        "name": "How do custom endpoints work?",
                        "acceptedAnswer": {
                            "@type": "Answer",
                            "text": "Custom endpoints let you shape responses around your collections or specific UX flows. Define the path, method, and response data-ideal for staging environments, automation callbacks, and UI experiments. Higher limits are available on Premium."
                        }
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Question",
                        "name": "What are the different API key types?",
                        "acceptedAnswer": {
                            "@type": "Answer",
                            "text": "ReqRes offers three API key permission levels: read-only (GET only), read/write (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH), and manage (includes DELETE operations). Use admin keys for managing collections and automations; use session tokens for per-user data access."
                        }
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Question",
                        "name": "What is the Data Explorer?",
                        "acceptedAnswer": {
                            "@type": "Answer",
                            "text": "The Data Explorer is a web interface that lets you browse collections, inspect request logs, and debug user journeys. Filter and export your stored objects with richer observability on paid plans."
                        }
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Question",
                        "name": "Can I use ReqRes for production?",
                        "acceptedAnswer": {
                            "@type": "Answer",
                            "text": "Yes. Pro and Premium provide persistent collections, app users, automations, and observability suitable for production workloads. SLA and security reviews are available on Enterprise."
                        }
                    },
                    {
                        "@type": "Question",
                        "name": "How does the Image to API feature work?",
                        "acceptedAnswer": {
                            "@type": "Answer",
                            "text": "The Image to API feature uses AI to analyze UI screenshots and automatically generate working API endpoints. Upload a screenshot of your design (or a Figma frame), and we generate REST endpoints and schemas you can deploy. Available on all plans with different usage limits; deployment requires Pro or above."
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }
        </script>

    <body class="dark-site bg-black text-white">
        <!--
          Cross-subdomain signed-in awareness. The dashboard (app.reqres.in)
          writes `rr_signed_in=1` on domain `.reqres.in` when Clerk has a
          user. This tiny inline script runs before <main> and adds an
          `rr-signed-in` class to <html> so downstream CSS + the welcome
          banner below can react without a second network request.
        -->
        <script>
            (function () {
                try {
                    if (/(?:^|;\s*)rr_signed_in=1(?:;|$)/.test(document.cookie)) {
                        document.documentElement.classList.add('rr-signed-in');
                    }
                } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
            })();
        </script>
        <div
            id="rr-welcome-back-banner"
            style="display: none; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18); position: relative; z-index: 60;"
        >
            <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
                <span style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);">
                    Welcome back - you're signed in.
                </span>
                <a
                    href="https://app.reqres.in/dashboard"
                    style="color: #6ee7b7; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none;"
                >
                    Open your dashboard →
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>
        <style>
            html.rr-signed-in #rr-welcome-back-banner { display: block !important; }
        </style>

    <!-- COMPANY LOGO CLOUD -->
    <!-- SVG Filters for animated dither effect -->
    <svg class="sr-only" aria-hidden="true">
        <defs>
            <filter id="dither-filter" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%">
                <feTurbulence
                    type="fractalNoise"
                    baseFrequency="0.8"
                    numOctaves="4"
                    seed="0"
                    result="noise"
                >
                    <animate
                        attributeName="seed"
                        from="0"
                        to="100"
                        dur="0.5s"
                        repeatCount="indefinite"
                    />
                </feTurbulence>
                <feDisplacementMap
                    in="SourceGraphic"
                    in2="noise"
                    scale="3"
                    xChannelSelector="R"
                    yChannelSelector="G"
                />
            </filter>
            <filter id="dither-hover" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
                <feTurbulence
                    type="fractalNoise"
                    baseFrequency="0.5"
                    numOctaves="2"
                    seed="0"
                    result="noise"
                >
                    <animate
                        id="dither-animation"
                        attributeName="seed"
                        from="0"
                        to="50"
                        dur="0.4s"
                        repeatCount="indefinite"
                    />
                </feTurbulence>
                <feComponentTransfer in="noise" result="threshold">
                    <feFuncR type="discrete" tableValues="0 1"/>
                    <feFuncG type="discrete" tableValues="0 1"/>
                    <feFuncB type="discrete" tableValues="0 1"/>
                </feComponentTransfer>
                <feBlend in="SourceGraphic" in2="threshold" mode="overlay" result="blended"/>
                <!-- Clip to source alpha so dither only shows on logo pixels -->
                <feComposite in="blended" in2="SourceGraphic" operator="in"/>
            </filter>
        </defs>
    </svg>

      .diagram-glow::before {
        content: '';

        padding: 1px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(52,211,153,0.30) 0%, rgba(52,211,153,0.10) 35%, rgba(52,211,153,0.03) 60%, rgba(52,211,153,0) 100%);
        -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
        -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
        mask-composite: exclude;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .infra-node { transition: all 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.1, 1); }
      .client-node { transition: all 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.1, 1); }
      .glow-ring {
        position: absolute;
        border-radius: 20px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08);
        animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .glow-ring:nth-child(1) { inset: -14px; animation-delay: 0s; }
      .glow-ring:nth-child(2) { inset: -30px; border-radius: 28px; animation-delay: 1s; }
      .glow-ring:nth-child(3) { inset: -46px; border-radius: 36px; animation-delay: 2s; }
      @keyframes glowPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; } 50% { opacity: 0.7; } }
      .stress-mark {
        position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 2px;
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.45); border-radius: 1px;
        animation: stressBlink 0.9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .stress-mark:nth-child(1) { top: -6px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-25deg); }
      .stress-mark:nth-child(2) { top: -4px; right: -4px; transform: rotate(35deg); animation-delay: 0.3s; }
      .stress-mark:nth-child(3) { top: -7px; left: -2px; transform: rotate(-45deg); animation-delay: 0.5s; }
      @keyframes stressBlink { 0% { opacity: 0.25; } 100% { opacity: 0.65; } }
      .svg-line { transition: all 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.1, 1); }
      .phase-btn { transition: all 0.35s ease; }
    </style>

              <span class="text-[8px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] text-white/25"><s class="decoration-white/45">OAuth</s> ✓</span>
              <span class="text-[8px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] text-white/25"><s class="decoration-white/45">Express</s> ✓</span>
              <span class="text-[8px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] text-white/25"><s class="decoration-white/45">AWS</s> ✓</span>
              <span class="text-[8px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] text-white/25"><s class="decoration-white/45">Datadog</s> ✓</span>

    <script>
    (function() {
      const btns = document.querySelectorAll('#diagramToggle button');
      const tagline = document.getElementById('diagramTagline');
    
      // Desktop elements
      const infraNodes = document.querySelectorAll('#diagramDesktop .infra-node');
      const clientNodes = document.querySelectorAll('#diagramDesktop .client-node');
      const urlHub = document.getElementById('urlHub');
      const beforeLines = document.querySelectorAll('.before-line');
      const youLines = document.querySelectorAll('.you-line');
      const afterLines = document.querySelectorAll('.after-line');
      const afterDots = document.querySelectorAll('.after-dot');
      const afterPackets = document.querySelectorAll('.after-packet');
    
      // Mobile elements
      const mobileBefore = document.getElementById('mobileBefore');
      const mobileAfter = document.getElementById('mobileAfter');
    
      let currentPhase = 'before';
      let autoTimer = null;
      let userInteracted = false;
      let sectionVisible = false;
    
      const prefersReducedMotion = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
      const desktopSvg = document.querySelector('#diagramDesktop svg');
    
      const startAuto = () => {
        if (autoTimer || prefersReducedMotion || userInteracted || !sectionVisible || document.hidden) return;
        autoTimer = setInterval(() => { setPhase(currentPhase === 'before' ? 'with' : 'before'); }, 4500);
      };
      const stopAuto = () => {
        if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
      };
      const pauseSmil = () => { if (desktopSvg && desktopSvg.pauseAnimations) desktopSvg.pauseAnimations(); };
      const resumeSmil = () => { if (desktopSvg && desktopSvg.unpauseAnimations) desktopSvg.unpauseAnimations(); };
    
      // Store original desktop positions
      const origPos = {};
      infraNodes.forEach(n => { origPos[n.id] = { left: n.style.left, top: n.style.top, right: n.style.right }; });
    
      function setPhase(phase) {
        currentPhase = phase;
        btns.forEach(b => {
          const active = b.dataset.phase === phase;
          b.className = 'phase-btn text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] font-semibold px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md border cursor-pointer '
            + (active ? 'border-emerald-400/25 bg-emerald-500/[0.06] text-emerald-300' : 'border-white/[0.08] bg-transparent text-white/50');
        });
    
        // ── Desktop ──
        if (phase === 'before') {
          infraNodes.forEach(n => {
            const o = origPos[n.id];
            if (o.left) n.style.left = o.left;
            if (o.top) n.style.top = o.top;
            if (o.right) n.style.right = o.right;
            n.style.opacity = '1';
            n.style.transform = '';
          });
          beforeLines.forEach(l => l.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0.04'));
          youLines.forEach(l => l.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0.03'));
          afterLines.forEach(l => l.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0'));
          afterDots.forEach(d => d.setAttribute('opacity', '0'));
          afterPackets.forEach(p => p.setAttribute('opacity', '0'));
          clientNodes.forEach(n => n.style.opacity = '0');
          urlHub.style.opacity = '0';
        } else {
          infraNodes.forEach(n => {
            n.style.opacity = '0';
            n.style.transform = 'scale(0.3)';
            n.style.left = '42%';
            n.style.top = '42%';
            n.style.right = 'auto';
          });
          beforeLines.forEach(l => l.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0'));
          youLines.forEach(l => l.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0'));
          afterLines.forEach(l => l.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0.15'));
          afterDots.forEach(d => d.setAttribute('opacity', '1'));
          afterPackets.forEach(p => p.setAttribute('opacity', '0.8'));
          clientNodes.forEach((n, i) => { setTimeout(() => { n.style.opacity = '1'; }, 200 + i * 120); });
          urlHub.style.opacity = '1';
        }
    
        // ── Mobile ──
        if (phase === 'before') {
          mobileBefore.style.display = '';
          mobileAfter.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
          mobileBefore.style.display = 'none';
          mobileAfter.style.display = '';
        }
    
        // ── Tagline ──
        if (phase === 'before') {
          tagline.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/65 font-medium">80% of backends</span> are CRUD + auth.<br>That\'s a lot of infra you\'re maintaining for nothing.';
        } else {
          tagline.innerHTML = '<span class="text-white/65 font-medium">Database, auth, CRUD, hosting</span> - handled.<br>Just send requests.';
        }
      }
    
      btns.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        userInteracted = true;
        stopAuto();
        setPhase(b.dataset.phase);
      }));
      setPhase('before');
    
      const section = document.getElementById('how');
      if (section && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
          entries.forEach(entry => {
            sectionVisible = entry.isIntersecting;
            if (sectionVisible) { resumeSmil(); startAuto(); }
            else { pauseSmil(); stopAuto(); }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.1 });
        io.observe(section);
      } else {
        sectionVisible = true;
        startAuto();
      }
    
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.hidden) { pauseSmil(); stopAuto(); }
        else if (sectionVisible) { resumeSmil(); startAuto(); }
      });
    })();
    </script>
    
    <!-- ═══ END DROP-IN SECTION ═══ -->
    <!-- ═══ INTERACTIVE TERMINAL WIDGET ═══ -->
    
    <style>
      /* Terminal font - JetBrains Mono loaded via <link> in layout.html */

        0%, 50% { opacity: 1; }

        height: 16px;
        background: #22C55E;
        margin-left: 2px;

        animation: terminalBlink 0.8s step-end infinite;

      /* Boot line animation */

      }
      .method-pill:focus-visible {

      }
      .method-pill.active[data-method="GET"] {

      .method-pill.active[data-method="POST"] {

      .method-pill.active[data-method="DELETE"] {
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);
        border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35);
        color: #F87171;
      }
    
      /* GET pill pulse animation for nudge */
      @keyframes getPulse {
        0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0); }
        50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); }
      }
      .method-pill.pulse-get {
        animation: getPulse 1s ease-in-out 3;
      }
    
      /* Audience toggle */
      .audience-btn {
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
        border-radius: 0.5rem;
        font-size: 0.8125rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);

        background: transparent;

        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
      }

        outline: none;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.5);
      }
      .audience-btn.active {
        background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1);
        color: #34D399;
      }
    
      /* Status badges */
      .status-badge {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem;
        border-radius: 0.375rem;

        font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      }
      .status-success {
        background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
        border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25);

      }
      .status-error {
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
        border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);

        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

      }
    
      /* JSON syntax highlighting */
      .json-key { color: #E2E8F0; }
      .json-string { color: #34D399; }
      .json-number { color: #67E8F9; }
      .json-boolean { color: #FBBF24; }
      .json-null { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); }
      .json-bracket { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); }
    
      /* Code editor with syntax highlighting */
      .code-editor-wrapper {
        position: relative;
        border-radius: 0.5rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
